request.parsed: empty on parse, validated parsed fields on decide

input.candidates: empty on parse; at most 200 authorized row objects with unique key on decide

decide.keys: exactly one approved key for count; otherwise empty
decide.after: optional: empty|next_group|wcs|validate|pack; fixed service rechecks authorization

helpers.between(raw, separator, start, end): between 1-based delimiter occurrences; empty segments preserved

execution: Pure JSON only. No ORM, imports, eval, network, arbitrary JS or frontend commands. Fixed services execute approved actions.
